PEUGEOT i -Connect ® Advanced
PEUGEOT i-Connect® Advanced offers a complete technological experience
with TomTom® connected navigation . For optimal readability, the card can
be displayed on the entire 10 -inch HD touchscreen and updated “live” (once
a month) . It is also fully and easily customizable with widgets, such as a
tablet .
«OK PEUGEOT», a natural language speech recognition control, improves
the safety and comfort of the user, and gives access to all the features .
Finally, to help the user,
PEUGEOT i-Connect® Advanced offers embedded documentation and
tutorials .
Vehicle  2 Load
V2L function is easy to use: the user plugs an adaptor
(available as an Accessory from PEUGEOT retailers) into the
car’s type 2 socket. Electrical devices can then be plugged into
the adaptor. 
When V2L is activated, a minimum 30% State of
Charge (SOC) threshold (pre -set & not adjustable) will be set by
the car; once the threshold is reached, V2L will be deactivated.
